Lower Text: [When Attacking] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits from your trash for its digivolution cost.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Trash 1 of them, and add 1 card with [Undead] or [Dark Animal] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
